answer_1.quote: We introduced DocLLM, a lightweight extension to traditional LLMs, tailored for generative reasoning over documents with rich layouts.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to visual question answering, key information extraction, document classification, and natural language inference tasks over visually rich documents.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluate all VQA datasets using Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS), with the exception of VisualMRC, for which we use CIDEr, and WTQ, for which we use accuracy. Performance on all CLS and NLI datasets is measured using accuracy. We evaluate all KIE datasets with the F1 score.
